verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are plain async functions that can be triggered and awaited from within other tasks (triggerAndWait, task.trigger), letting developers build reusable, callable sub-tasks/modules composed into larger workflows without a DSL. This is well documented but Trigger.dev is code-first rather than a visual builder, so there's no explicit 'sub-workflow' UI construct or independent corroboration of complex nested composition patterns. Missing for 10: explicit visual/drag-and-drop sub-workflow composition, dedicated terminology for reusable modules, and hands-on community confirmation of deep nesting patterns.
